notes: Company snapshot: mid-size CX platform that resells SaaS support suites to retail + fintech clients.
Primary problem: agents overwhelmed during sale peaks — average ticket backlog spikes 3x on promo days, turnaround SLA breaches.
They want: automated email/ticket summaries (1-2 sentences), auto-tagging for routing + priority, suggested macros, and ability to trigger tool-calls (e.g., send refund link via API).
Quote from CTO: "We cannot tolerate false positives on 'fraud' tag — want confidence + manual-override flow."
Data constraints: customer data includes PII (email, partial card identifiers), need KMS + strict retention policy (30-90 days depending on client).
Current stack: Zendesk primarily; some clients on Freshdesk. Also use AWS (us-east-1) and Okta for SSO.
PoC ask: 14-day trial with sample of 10k tickets (sanitized), evaluate p95 latency under 50 req/sec spikes, and accuracy of tag mapping vs human labels.
Cost sensitivity: medium — willing to commit to Dedicated if unit economics beat current human tagging costs by ~40%.
Preferred model behavior: deterministic summarization template, structured tags + confidence score, ability to tune tokenization for redaction before logging.
Important: must integrate with existing Zendesk macros and support webhook-based tool-calls; want function-calling demo that executes a refund flow in sandbox.
requirements_summary: Core features: 1-2 sentence email/ticket summaries; automated multi-label tagging; confidence scores; suggested macros; safe tool-calling hooks
Performance: avg latency target <250ms for edge cases, p95 <700ms; sustain bursts up to 200 req/sec in peak windows
Security/compliance: support SSO/SAML, SOC2 compliance, KMS integration, per-client retention control, data residency (NA-only), audit logs
Integration: out-of-the-box connectors for Zendesk + Freshdesk; webhook or API-based macro execution; mapping to existing tag taxonomy
Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency, error tracing, tagging drift monitors
p0_metrics: Summarization F1 target >= 0.78 on human-labeled set
Tagging precision >= 0.85 for priority/issue-type top-5 tags
False positive rate for fraud tag < 1%
